relations.title: Transferencia de contexto
relations.reading: Cross-border operational handoffs should preserve the responsible entity, jurisdiction and delegated scope rather than treating continuity as uniform authority.

relations.title: Transmisión de juicio tácito
relations.reading: Cross-border knowledge transfer includes the ability to handle local exceptions, not merely the movement of manuals or personnel.

relations.title: Estado de una afirmación
relations.reading: The distributed-work lineage supplies practitioner motivation and design context, not an independent HID measurement or population-level causal result.

relations.title: Decisión de arquitectura
relations.reading: Distributed American Innovation becomes operationally intelligible when the team itself integrates field interpretation, engineering and responsibility for the receiving operation.

relations.title: Transferencia de contexto
relations.reading: The early distributed-team lineage explains why cross-border work required information discipline and operational continuity long before remote work became a workplace category.

relations.title: Nivel y frontera del resultado
relations.reading: Field capability and programme performance belong to different levels; the Chicontepec integration case adds the contractual, territorial and governance conditions between them.

relations.title: Decisión de arquitectura
relations.reading: The oilfield deployment illustrates the team-as-system principle: legal, plant, quality and training workstreams must become one usable operating model rather than a collection of completed deliverables.

relations.title: Activación entre tipos de frontera
relations.reading: Distributed American Innovation offers a field-oriented lens on how territorial, social and technical frontiers can activate one another through operating networks.

relations.title: Doble inserción operativa de portadores
relations.reading: The industrial-corridor account offers a way to examine dual embeddedness through actual translation of operating requirements, rather than geography alone.

relations.title: Marco semántico común de una intersección
relations.reading: Distributed field observations can be combined meaningfully only after their question, event, scope and time references have been aligned.

relations.title: Función federada de integridad
relations.reading: Participant-local positioning offers a later architectural comparison for distributed operational intelligence without presuming one global controller or shared objective.

relations.title: Admisibilidad contextual
relations.reading: A distributed network can exchange qualified signals while each participant retains responsibility for its own question, scope and reliance decision.
